blocks.orig: In the heart of western Serengeti, perched on the higher grounds in the region of Nyasirori, Mila Tented Camp provides a lovely out-of-Africa feeling. With just 5 double tents and 1 family tent, the camp promises peaceful luxury and secluded privacy. Inside the tents, the decoration is inspired by local tribes and natural colours. Comfortable beds, fans, ensuite bathrooms, and wildlife viewing all around the camp… it’s all you need to relax after a dusty safari day. Add to this tasty meals and a cosy campfire, and you might even want to extend your stay!
blocks.html: Set on higher ground in the Nyasirori region, in the heart of western Serengeti, Mila Tented Camp gives you a wonderful out-of-Africa feeling. There are only 5 double tents and 1 family tent, so you can count on quiet luxury and secluded privacy. The interiors of the tents draw on local tribes and natural colours. Comfortable beds, fans, ensuite bathrooms and wildlife to watch all around the camp… it’s everything you need to unwind after a dusty day on safari. Add good food and a cosy campfire, and you may well want to stay longer!
